sources.snippet: The 8B is faster and more power-efficient; the 70B is more capable. Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-GGUF by bartowski combines both improvements: it is the larger, newer model using llama.cpp release b3472. It demands the most hardware but delivers the best instruction-following quality in this family.
